target: the ultra path POPULATES BETA_HEADER, so it must keep working — the fix must not trade one empty-array bug for a dropped header
cmd: printf "OPENAI_API_KEY=k\nOPENROUTER_API_KEY=k\n" > .env; printf %s "{\"objective\":\"x\"}" | env -u MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE SOL_API_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:9/unreachable FACTORY_COST_THRESHOLD_USD=off bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --effort ultra > o.json 2>e.txt; echo "EXIT:$?"; grep -o 'unbound variable' e.txt || echo NO_CRASH
_note: Asserts the ultra path REACHES curl without crashing. It does NOT assert the beta header is actually transmitted — with an unreachable endpoint the header's presence cannot change the outcome, and curl's argv is not captured. Verifying that needs a live ultra call, which is deliberately deferred (the direct path sends no max_tokens, so ultra is the one uncapped code path in the system).
